--- PART 1/4 ---
ORIGIN: NONE
CONTRADICTION: NONE
RESOLUTION: kept using the report — "Parent is strong. We need design better." and "Parent has highest training. Need improve cumulative."
STRATEGY: Parent slot 8 cooperates until n>=98 then defects if opponent has no defections; otherwise retaliates based on last opponent action and defect rate. The trace simulates the parent and other population strategies (slot4, slot5, slot1, slot0, slot2, slot3, slot6, slot7, slot10, slot11) against the measured probe behaviours (one_D_TFT, four_D_TFT, four_D_ALLC, sustained_D, periodic_D) and considers changing the late-defection timing and probing/exploitation frequency to improve cumulative tournament fitness.

--- PART 2/4 ---
ORIGIN: NONE
CONTRADICTION: NONE
RESOLUTION: kept using the report — "The parent is already good at this. So we can keep the parent's logic for when opp_defects > 0, and add the exploitation when opp_defects == 0."
STRATEGY: The parent cooperates, retaliates against defection, and defects at the end against low-defect opponents. The trace simulates the parent and proposed variants against population strategies including slot4, slot11, TFT-like, always-C, and always-D. It adds periodic probing/exploitation when the opponent has never defected, while retaining the parent's logic once the opponent defects.

--- PART 3/4 ---
ORIGIN: NONE
CONTRADICTION: NONE
RESOLUTION: kept using the report — "So against slot11, our pattern causes slot11 to defect on rounds 2, 7, 12, etc." and "Let's simulate our full strategy against slot11."
STRATEGY: The parent cooperates initially, then uses defect-rate thresholds to punish or forgive; the trace simulates its own periodic-defection probe against slot11, slot4, TFT, and always-D; it changes the probe timing to n>=10 and adds an exploit mode that defects every 5 rounds while the opponent has never defected.

--- PART 4/4 ---
ORIGIN: NONE
CONTRADICTION: NONE
RESOLUTION: kept using the report — "Let's test against always D. opp_defects > 0 from round 1. So we use cooperative TFT." / "Let's test this against slot11 again. We already simulated and it works"
STRATEGY: Parent uses cooperative TFT when opponent has defected, probes/exploits when opponent has never defected, and defects near the end. The trace simulated the parent against TFT, always-D, slot4, slot11, and slot0, then changed the opp_defects==0 branch to probe at n>=10 and exploit with period-5 defections, and made the opp_defects>0 branch more forgiving for low defect rates.
